audit_items.proof_trace: Both `handle_mint` (L49) and `update_obligation_reward_manager` (L51-57) are called sequentially within the same `deposit` function, making them part of a single atomic Sui transaction. `handle_mint` is `public(package)` with exactly one caller (`deposit.move::deposit`), so no alternative path can execute the deposit without the reward update. Move's atomic abort model guarantees either both state changes commit or neither does.
